decision_scope: Choose between the six-course pre-vNext candidate set and the six-course vNext candidate set. This decision does not merge, overwrite, or delete the original 143-course Approved/Owner Review corpus.

original_143_corpus.rule: Retain existing Approved/Owner Review history and archival lineage. Never silently fold this dataset into a candidate set.

when_owner_selects_one_candidate: Set selected candidate status to CURRENT_SELECTED.
Keep its exact selected version in archival storage and mark the archived record CURRENT_SELECTED_SNAPSHOT.
Promote only the selected candidate into the active learner-facing current-state course surface.
Set the non-selected candidate status to ARCHIVE_ONLY.
Do not delete or overwrite the original 143-course corpus; it remains independently retrievable for lineage and pull-forward use.
promotion_rule.before_future_rewrite: Snapshot the then-current selected version verbatim before modifying it. New versions append; they do not overwrite archive history.

mixed_review_ui.reason: Owner requires complete dataset separation rather than old/new content rendered together.
